turns.text: Today we're deciding: Choose a household cleaning upgrade. The household wants one primary upgrade. All listed prices are within the available budget. Options: A) Robot Vacuum — price: 260 euros; task: daily floor cleaning; setup: clear floor paths (+ reduces routine floor work; − does not clean dishes) B) Weekly Cleaner — price: 80 euros per visit; task: full weekly cleaning; schedule: Saturday morning (+ covers several rooms; − requires a fixed appointment) C) Dishwasher Upgrade — price: 480 euros; task: dish cleaning; capacity: 12 place settings (+ removes daily dishwashing; − does not clean floors) D) Shared Chore Plan — price: free; task: manual rotation; schedule: three sessions per week (+ no purchase cost; − requires consistent participation)
Option C is the best choice since it removes the daily dishwashing, which is our most frustrating recurring chore.
